study.title: Data-efficient design of high-entropy oxygen carriers for chemical looping using active learning
study.citation: Brorsson et al., ACS Materials Au 6, 319-326 (2026); companion account Brorsson et al., Materials Today Energy 57, 102239 (2026); preprint Brorsson et al., METAL preprint, arXiv:2601.03933.
study.workflow_type: Closed-loop active learning: WAE-GMM composition generation, Gaussian-process surrogate, Thompson sampling, CHGNet thermodynamic evaluation
study.assessment_scope: Completed from the two publications, their Supporting Information, and the preprint of the companion account only. The record covers the oxygen-transfer-capacity campaign; locations in the companion account refer to the preprint numbering.

items.entry: Active learning with a generative composition model identifies ABO3 perovskites with high configurational entropy and high calculated oxygen transfer capacity (OTC) between reducing (1050 °C, pO2 = 1e-14 atm) and oxidising (950 °C, pO2 = 0.2 atm) conditions. Evidence level: thermodynamics computed with CHGNet; no DFT validation and no synthesis. Comparison: Thompson sampling relative to random and greedy acquisition, and the final candidates relative to the initial pool.
source_locations: Brorsson et al., ACS Materials Au 6, 319-326 (2026), pp. 322-324
Brorsson et al., METAL preprint, arXiv:2601.03933, Sec. III

items.entry: Given in stage_ledger below; the per-cycle and campaign counts are not stated in the publications.
not_stated: proposals, screened candidates, and evaluated candidates per cycle
source_locations: Brorsson et al., ACS Materials Au 6, 319-326 (2026), pp. 322-324
Brorsson et al., METAL preprint, arXiv:2601.03933, Secs. II-III

items.entry: No external labelled dataset is used. The initial pool consists of 1,815 randomly generated compositions in 80-atom ABO3 supercells with up to seven metallic elements (A site: Ca, Ba, K, La, Sm, Sr, Y; B site: Co, Cu, Fe, Mn, Mg, Ni, Ti), of which 1,066 satisfy charge neutrality and a Bartel tolerance factor of at most 4.18 and are labelled with CHGNet. Results are reported after removal of duplicate entries.
source_locations: Brorsson et al., METAL preprint, arXiv:2601.03933, Sec. II.A
Brorsson et al., ACS Materials Au 6, 319-326 (2026), pp. 323-324

items.entry: No train-test partition: the models are retrained on the growing database of labelled compositions in every cycle, and the claim concerns the candidates found rather than surrogate accuracy. Gaussian-process hyperparameters are fitted by maximising the marginal likelihood.
source_locations: Brorsson et al., ACS Materials Au 6, 319-326 (2026), p. 322
Brorsson et al., METAL preprint, arXiv:2601.03933, Secs. II.B-II.C

items.entry: Two normalised seven-dimensional vectors of A- and B-site occupations. WAE: encoder 80-64-48 with layer normalisation, ReLU, and 10% dropout in the first hidden layer; eight-dimensional latent space; composition decoder 48-64-80 with a softmax per sublattice; property decoder 192-256-320; L1 reconstruction loss and a maximum-mean-discrepancy penalty against a Gaussian prior with a weight in [0, 1]. GMM fitted to the latent encodings. GP: GPyTorch, Matérn kernel with one length scale per input dimension and an output scale, operating on the composition vectors. Different random seeds for the parallel runs.
not_stated: number of GMM components and covariance type
source_locations: Brorsson et al., METAL preprint, arXiv:2601.03933, Secs. II.B-II.C
Brorsson et al., ACS Materials Au 6, 319-326 (2026), SI Fig. S2 and Note S1

items.entry: GP hyperparameters are optimised with Adam on the negative marginal log-likelihood.
not_stated: WAE optimiser, learning rate, epochs, and batch size
whether models are retrained from scratch in each cycle
source_locations: Brorsson et al., METAL preprint, arXiv:2601.03933, Sec. II.C.1

items.entry: In every cycle, latent points are sampled from the GMM, decoded to compositions, filtered for charge neutrality, a tolerance factor of at most 4.18, and configurational entropy of at least 1.5R, and passed to acquisition.
not_stated: rounding of fractional compositions to site occupations
source_locations: Brorsson et al., ACS Materials Au 6, 319-326 (2026), p. 321 and SI Note S1
Brorsson et al., METAL preprint, arXiv:2601.03933, Secs. II.A.2 and II.B.3

items.entry: Task success is the OTC, 0.5 Δδ M(O2)/M, with the non-stoichiometry limited to δ ≤ 0.5. All 20 OTC values reported for the top-ranked candidates are reproduced with Δδ = 0.5, the maximum permitted, so that their ranking is set by molar mass; the values are reproduced with the molar mass of the reduced phase, whereas the published expression refers to that of ABO3. Novelty: compositions are compared with previously labelled entries.
not_stated: agreement between GP predictions and CHGNet values of acquired candidates
spread of the outcome across parallel runs
source_locations: Brorsson et al., ACS Materials Au 6, 319-326 (2026), pp. 321 and 324
Brorsson et al., METAL preprint, arXiv:2601.03933, Table IV

items.entry: Chemical validity: charge neutrality and perovskite formability (tolerance factor ≤ 4.18). Thermodynamic stability: CHGNet relaxation (ASE BFGS, forces below 0.001 eV/Å) of 19 special quasirandom structures per composition across cubic, orthorhombic, and brownmillerite configurations, δ from 0 to 0.5 in steps of 0.0625; formation energies relative to a Materials Project phase diagram without Materials Project corrections, cross-checked against M3GNet; energy above hull is not used as a criterion. Dynamical stability: harmonic phonons (phonopy, 0.02 Å displacements, supercells of at least 12.5 Å) computed for the vibrational free energy. Synthesis and experiment: not performed; the candidates are computational nominations at the CHGNet evidence level.
not_stated: whether the reported candidates show imaginary phonon modes
source_locations: Brorsson et al., ACS Materials Au 6, 319-326 (2026), p. 324 and SI Fig. S3
Brorsson et al., METAL preprint, arXiv:2601.03933, Sec. III.A

items.entry: Thompson sampling is compared with random selection in the dry-reforming proof of concept and with greedy selection in this campaign, using the same generator, filters, and evaluator. Not reported: a random or enumerative search of the same composition space at the same number of CHGNet evaluations, and an ablation of the generative model. Consequence: the published record supports improvement of OTC relative to the initial pool, but not superiority over simpler search strategies.
source_locations: Brorsson et al., ACS Materials Au 6, 319-326 (2026), Fig. 2
Brorsson et al., METAL preprint, arXiv:2601.03933, Sec. III

items.entry: Thompson sampling from the GP predictive distribution with n candidates per cycle, where n is the number of parallel evaluations; UQ by GP predictive variance; parallel runs of 10 cycles from the same initial pool with different seeds, merged and continued for 40 cycles; a fixed number of cycles as stopping rule. The Letter describes five parallel runs, the companion account ten.
source_locations: Brorsson et al., METAL preprint, arXiv:2601.03933, Sec. II.C.2
Brorsson et al., ACS Materials Au 6, 319-326 (2026), p. 323
Brorsson et al., Materials Today Energy 57, 102239 (2026), Fig. 6 and Sec. 3.3

items.entry: Oxide oxygen carriers for energy applications; no hazardous target, autonomous execution pathway, or access restriction.

1,815 random compositions, of which 1,066 passed the chemistry screen and were labelled with CHGNet; parallel runs of 10 cycles, merged and continued for 40 cycles; 20 candidates reported at the CHGNet evidence level, with the highest OTC of 0.057 g(O2)/g(OC) for Ca13CoMgMn9Ti5Y3O48. The number of candidates evaluated per cycle and in total is not stated, so the outcome cannot be expressed per evaluation.
not_stated: candidates evaluated per cycle and in total
